title: Extract orthogonality and unitarity defect analysis
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed defect-analysis task only; it does not select a metric or tolerance.
objective: Extract repeated orthogonality and unitarity defect calculations into explicit analyzers for real column embeddings and complex unitary representations.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation, define the represented Gram or unitary residual, norm, matrix dimensions, scalar field, and tolerance-reporting boundary.
Keep defect measurement separate from repair, orthogonalization, gauge alignment, and acceptance policy.
Migrate at least two real consumers for each introduced abstraction.
completion_criteria: Orthogonality and unitarity result objects state the exact residual and metric used.
Real and complex consumers preserve retained values and no longer duplicate matching formulas.
Tests use independent analytical matrices and explicit binary64 tolerances.
exclusions: Do not infer physical equivalence, gauge alignment, or subspace identity from a small defect alone.
Do not add automatic repair or alter campaign acceptance thresholds.
No scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, protected execution, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
